name: Prepare a PowerPoint deck for presenting and sharing
why: Finishes a deck with speaker notes, an accessibility review and a handout, the same end point as this kit's deck workflow.

name: Turn a report into an editable briefing deck
why: Builds an editable deck from a report with slide text checked against the source, so no number is invented.

name: Turn a messy spreadsheet into a clean slide deck
why: Cleans the data first, then writes the story and slides, useful before the chart choice prompt.

name: PowerPoint template populator
why: Fills a team's PowerPoint template with approved text and data while keeping its layouts, after the template skill sets them up.

name: PowerPoint slide size converter
why: Moves an old 4:3 deck to 16:9 without stretched images, a common first job before a redesign.

name: PowerPoint editable chart rebuilder
why: Rebuilds pasted chart pictures as editable charts, so they can follow the template's chart rules.

name: Pitch deck 10/20/30 checker
why: Scores a pitch deck on slide count, time and type size, a quick check alongside the deck layout plan.

name: Prepare a webinar people can follow
why: Plans a teaching webinar and its slide brief, for talks where the deck has to teach one clear result.

name: Page grid and type planner
why: Plans margins, columns and a type list for reports and printed pages, the base of a workbook style system.

name: Font pair shortlist maker
why: Shortlists headline and body font pairs with sizes, a quick start for a type scale.

name: Layout default breaker
why: Finds the layout choices software made by default on a page, cover or slide and offers hand-made alternatives.

name: Make a long form easier to finish
why: Cuts a long web form to the fields that matter and tests the flow, the online side of the form skill.

name: Coupon and form fixer
why: Fixes a sign-up or reply form so it asks only what is needed, a small version of a form redesign.

name: Pick a lead magnet, then build its path and page
why: Chooses the lead magnet and its sign-up path before the workbook or checklist is laid out.

name: Pack and thumbnail glance tester
why: A 3-second glance test at small size, the same check a book cover needs in an online store.
